en: <CLT=cltMIND>Hm...Kaito's not here either?
Hey, has anyone seen Kaito!?

You seem in a panic.
Over the Kubs Pad if I'm not mistaken.
...What?
You're not the only one who got one, Shuichi.
We all did.

We have all been given "motive videos".
However, they have been mixed up.
Mixed up?

When I woke up, there was a Kubs Pad in my 
room, but the video on it wasn't even mine—

Tsumugi, we should discuss this once
everyone is here.
Oh, sorry... You're right.
What do you mean, once everyone is here?

Kaito and Keebo went to gather everyone 
else so that we may discuss our plans.

Shall we wait for everyone then? Until then,
I can provide you all with massages—

Thank you for waiting! We gathered everyone
else!

My word...and after I was about to finally 
experience one of Kirumi's famed massages...

Wh-What do you mean? Are you also suggesting
that I cannot read the air?
So what is it? Why did you drag us here?

Didn't I tell you?
It's about the Kubs Pads.

Monokuma gave us a new motive.
We can't *not* talk about it.

That thing that looks like another Monopad?
That was a <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

Maki, haven't you watched the video on the
Kubs Pad yet!?

No. I ignored it because I figured it was
something stupid.

That's actually really courageous 
in a weird sort of way...

You don't have to speak up, but this is
important, so you should at least listen.
So, what are these videos?

No doubt they're more <CLT=cltSTRONG>motives<CLT=cltNORMAL> from Monokuma,
but why were they all mixed up...?
Y-Yeah! Why Gonta get Tsumugi's video—
No! Don't say it, Gonta!

Aah...I heard it... I see... 
So Gonta has my video...
...Huh? Gonta not supposed to say it?

Who fuckin' cares!? We're gonna exchange 'em
anyway, right?
No, we cannot exchange them.
<CLT=cltMIND>What? We can't?

Why not? They're videos of the 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>most important people<CLT=cltNORMAL> in our lives.

And that is precisely why we cannot exchange
them.

Although we do not know why our <CLT=cltSTRONG>motives<CLT=cltNORMAL>
were mixed up...

As long as we don't exchange them, we don't
have to see our motives at all.
So it's better to just ignore them...
Yes. At least, that is what I think.

Th-That's true... If we ignore them, then we
won't have a <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
I'm against that.

Huh? Against it? Why? If you see that video, 
it'll turn into a <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>, right?
That's why I want to see it.
You do?

You were saying something like that before...
That you don't plan on surviving.

It might not matter to you whether 
you get killed or not, but...

We're different!
We all want to live!

Wake up already! You're like some zombie
wandering around with no will to live!

No will to live, huh? Hmph, if that's 
how you see me, then so be it.

But I've got no plans to change my opinion.
That's just not cool.
Wh-What did you say!?
Who cares? Ryoma just stated his opinion.
Actually...I feel the same way as him.
Are you...trying to cause trouble again?

Don't get the wrong idea. I'm not saying
we shouldn't care about killing or dying...

But I think it'd be better if we didn't <CLT=cltSTRONG>cooperate<CLT=cltNORMAL>
with each other...

Actually, we *definitely* shouldn't <CLT=cltSTRONG>cooperate<CLT=cltNORMAL>
with each other!
We shouldn't cooperate? Why not!?
Think back to all of Monokuma's actions so far.

Whenever we tried to work together, Monokuma
would retaliate with a plan to make us suffer.

It happened when Kaede wanted us to cooperate,
and again with these <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive videos<CLT=cltNORMAL>, right?

Which means, the more we try to cooperate,
the more he'll try to make us suffer.

You are saying that if we do not rally together,
we will not be made to suffer?

That's why I had no choice but to screw with
you guys. But you ingrates didn't even notice.
And you're not lying to us right now?

...Whether I'm lying or not, what I'm saying is
still true.

Anyway, we shouldn't force ourselves to 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>cooperate<CLT=cltNORMAL>. Let's just all do our own thing.
So, I agree with Ryoma's suggestion.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's *because* we're trying to cooperate
that Monokuma is making us suffer...?

<CLT=cltMIND>But what about...
everything we went through...?

<CLT=cltMIND>What was the point of Kaede
sacrificing herself...?
Anyway, I'm warning you all for your sake.

Let's just exchange our <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive videos<CLT=cltNORMAL>
instead of cooperating with each other.
...I cannot comprehend that logic.

Well, now that I've said I won't cooperate, I
can't afford to be seen with you losers...
C'mon, Gonta. Let's go.
What? Gonta, too!?

We promised to think of a way to get everyone
to exchange their <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive videos<CLT=cltNORMAL>, remember?

Anyway, Kirumi, I'll hit you up later when I'm
feeling hungry.
W-Wait! Did Gonta make promise!?
Why can't you tell when he's lying, Gonta?

Quit screwing around... "Our sake"?
Yeah, right. I've had it with his lies.
So are we all done here? Then I'm leaving.
Kirumi, bring me my dinner later.
I'm heading out too...
Wait up, Ryoma!

Don't forget. We're all struggling to get out 
of here alive.
So don't get in our way...

I've got no intention of getting in your way.
I'd never do something so uncool.

Kirumi, could I get you to clean 
my room later?
You guys are relying on Kirumi too much.

I do not mind... Serving others is the true
desire of any maid.

You shouldn't spoil people, though!
Especially degenerate males!

Our cooperation is the number one factor 
in our suffering, is it?

Kehehe... How, I wonder, will this turn out...?
I will observe with great interest...

Oh, and Kirumi, I shall have you record my
observations. I trust you to do it properly.

Hah-hahaha! Well, I'm certainly not gonna
hang out with a bunch of chumps like you!

Guess I'll go back, take a shit, and get some
sleep! Kirumi, think of an invention for me, okay!?

Wow... How much is everyone going 
to depend on Kirumi?

My workload has increased significantly...
This calls for a more tactical approach.

C'mon, you can't spoil them! They'll just turn
into ungrateful leeches!

...Wait, what's wrong, Himiko?
Are you hungry?

Then how about we eat together!?
Kirumi, one tripe hot pot please!
Tenko...you're giving her more work...

What's the matter, Himiko?
You don't like tripe hot pot?
You don't get it, Tenko. Himiko isn't hungry.
I know, cuz I have the almighty Atua.
Whatever! Let's just enjoy some tripe hot pot!
Geez, you're so careless, Tenko.

<CLT=cltMIND>In the end, those of us that stayed behind
had tripe hot pot for a quirky take on breakfast.

<CLT=cltMIND>We also promised not to show each other
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motives<CLT=cltMIND>.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>This is an oddly-shaped monitor...
<CLT=cltMIND>This looks like the dining hall rules.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"You may eat any food you
find in the dining hall."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Please take responsibility for all utensils and
dishes used and clean up after yourself."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"The dining hall will be locked
during nighttime."

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like you could get outside from here...
but it's completely blocked...
